summary: Kristofer Busching, 32, of New York died instantly of blunt force trauma after falling 60-80 feet down a slickrock formation in Mee Canyon; he and a 31-year-old companion had been lost for days after a short hike in Knowles Canyon went wrong; the companion was rescued exhausted and dehydrated after signaling rescuers with a fire; their two dogs survived with injuries.
location: Knowles Canyon / Mee Canyon, Rabbit Valley
responding_agency: Mesa County Sheriff's Office, Mesa County Search and Rescue (~30 volunteers), Centurylink helicopter
notes: Date is the rescue/recovery report date (Friday, per MCSO; article updated 2020-04-13); the fatal fall occurred ~2.5 days after the pair began hiking earlier that week. 1 fatality; companion rescued. Name widely published.
